description: Check a CSS selector, Playwright selector or locator (getByRole/getByTestId…, .first(), .filter()) on a live page: validity, match count (actions need exactly 1), sample matches and a sturdier verified locator for each. Accepts storageState/headers/actions.

actions.description: Steps run after load to reach a state (modal, step 3)

locator.description: Locator or selector, e.g. getByRole('button', { name: 'Next' })

value.description: fill text, press key, select option

projectRoot.description: Project whose Playwright launches the browser (default: server root)

selector.description: Selector or locator, e.g. getByRole('button', { name: 'Save' })

storageState.description: Logged-in session: storageState JSON inside the project, e.g. playwright/.auth/user.json

url.description: Full URL of the live page to test against (http/https)

name: validate-selector
title: Validate selector or locator
